title: Predisposition

inlines.v: PREDISPOSI'TION, noun Previous inclination or propensity to any thing; applied to the mind. 1. Previous fitness or adaptation to any change, impression or purpose; applied to matter; as the predisposition of the body to disease; the predisposition of the seasons to generate diseases.
